about: Public smoke set for the vault's embedding model (memory plan C3): invented mini-chats in Swiss German (gsw), German (de), English (en) and Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian (bcs), each with one search query (half cross-lingual). Not the owner's data. Used by `vault index eval` (numbers only) and tests/test_index.py (format).
